name: voice_core_e2e_acceptance_v1
_comment: ADR-0022 GATE-1 acceptance contract for voice_core_suite_v1.json.
Top-level expected_tool_calls is AND-semantics: every listed tool must appear
at least once in the whole run. Music chain = execute_music_code (start Renardo)
+ stop_music (stop). generate_music is intentionally EXCLUDED (MiniMax Music API
unavailable); gen_delete_from_library is intentionally EXCLUDED (not needed now).
must_not_call stays EMPTY at top-level — per-step constraints live in the steps.
